items.text: Dichi chikwasheli mafuku ayedi naŋaseka nimankendi akadi iluŋa, awakulumpi jawatupristu niansoneki hiyakukeŋakeŋa hakumukwatila namakasu kulonda amujahi;
Muloŋa elili nawu, Bayi mumafuku achawija ku, antu akenda kaleta ipumba.

Chadiŋiyi muBetanimwitala damukwambumba Shimona, chashakaminiyi nakudya, hikukwinza mumbanda namalasha anaradi abadika kulema wuseya, muchipunda chelola dalubanji. Hakufumpa chipunda, hakuyihuŋunwina kunamutu windi.
Ilaŋa kwadiŋi amakwawu atiyili kutama nankashi munyichima yawu, nawu, Chanakisaŋanuwu malashawa analondidi?
Malashawa neyi ayilandisha adi kufwika mali akubadika mumakulakaji asatu, ayinki atuzweŋi. Hiyakumunyinyita owu mumbanda.
Ilaŋa Yesu nindi, Mulekenu kwindi, mukumukabishiladi? Naŋilili mudimu wawuwahi.
Muloŋatuzweŋi mudi nawu mafuku ejima, honsu munakeŋeli kuyila chachiwahi mukutwesha; Ilaŋa mi hinidi nenu mafuku ejimaku.
Yena kwindi neli mwashika Ŋovu jindi; nawayishaŋahu dehi mujimba wami nanochu chakanjiikawu.
Nukuyileja chalala nami, kwejima kwamba kashimunawu nsaŋu yayiwahi mwahita matuŋa ejima, amba katenaŋa chaneliyi mumbandiwu kulonda kumwanuka nachu.
Yudasi Isakaroti wahekumi nayedi, hakuya kudi awakulumpi jawatupristu kulonda akamuhani kudi wena.
Niwena chanachitiyuwu, atiya nikuwaha, hiyakumukana kumwinka mali. Hakukeŋa hatela kumuhenena.
Hefuku damuchimu damankendi akadi iluŋi, hajahaŋawu mukoku wapaseka, atumbanji twindi hiyakumwila nawu, Wukukeŋa tuyi kudihi, twakakuloŋesheli kwakudiila paseka?
Hakutemesha atumbanji twindi ayedi, hakuyila nindi, Yenu muŋanda, mwakabulakani neyala nasendi nsaba yameji; mwakamulondi.
Mwonsu mwakeŋa ilayi mwakamwili mwini itala nenu, Nkuluŋaŋa nindi, Itala dami dawenyi munukudiila paseka nawatumbanji twami didi kudihi?
Yomwenindi wakayileja itala deneni dahewulu, mudi yuma yakupoŋomwena dehi; mwakatuloŋesheli mwenomu.
Owu atumbanji hiyakuya, hiyakushika muŋanda, hiyakuwana mwomwayilejeliyi; aloŋesha nipaseka.
Chikuneli melela, hakwinza nekumi nayedi.
Chanashakamuwu nakudya, Yesu hakwila nindi, Nukuyileja chalala nami, hadi mwinenu wumu wukunfukeja, yowu tudi nakudya nindi.
Hiyakutachika kuneŋa, hiyakumwila hamuntu hamuntu, iwu nindi, Yami tahindi? iwu nindi, Yami tahindi?
Hakuyila nindi, Hiwumu wahekumi nayedi, yowu wudi nakutanta nanami mucheŋa.
Muloŋa Mwana kamuntu hakuya mwomwamusonekeleluwu; ilaŋa o yihuŋu yanowu muntu wukufukeja Mwana kamuntu! Owu muntu neyi havwalikiluku mutenowu chachiwahi.
Chadiŋi nakudyawu, hakunona dinkendi, chanakisuliyi nkisu hakudihumuna, hakuyinka nindi, Tambulenu, diwu mujimba wami.
Hakunona lupasa, chanasakililiyi hakuyinka; hiyakunwamu wejima wawu.
Hakuyila nindi, Diwu mashi ami achitiyaŋenu akupwekela antu amavulu.
Nukuyileja chalala nami, hinamba kanwa cheŋi yanyikabu yamuvinyuku, chiŋa ifuku dinakanwa yayiha muwanta waNzambi.
Chanembuwu kamina, hiyakwidika, hiyakuya kumpidi yaOliveta.
Yesu hakuyila nindi, Mukudimboka wejima wenu; muloŋa anasoneki nawu, Nakatapa kabiŋa, ninyikoku yakapalaŋana ndu ndu.
Ilaŋa chakansaŋulawu mudi afu, nakayanahu dehi kuŊaliliya.
Ilaŋa Petulu hakumwila nindi, Hela ejima akudimboka, ami nehi.
Yesu hakumwila nindi, Nukukuleja chalala nami, eyi lelu, wufuku woweniwu, hakwila ikombu kanda edi kili kayedi, wukudikalami kasatu.
Ilana yena hakuhosha naŋovu nankashi nindi, Hela chakufwa neyi hamu, hinakadikala eyuku. Wejima wawu ahosheli mwomumu nawa.
Hiyakushika kwatenanawu nawu kuŋesemani; hakuyila atumbanji twindi nindi, Shakamenu hanu, niyi nilombi.
Hakuya nawaPetulu naYakoba niYowanu, hakutachika kuhayama nankashi, nikukaba nankashi.
Hakuyila nindi, Muchima wami wunaneni chakubadika, neyi kena nifwi; shalenu hanu nakutona.
Hakuswila kumbidi chanti, hakudinata hamaseki, hakulomba nindi, Neyi chinatwesheki, mpinji iyi yinfumi.
Hakwila nindi, Aba, Tata, yuma yejima yinatwesheki kudeyi; nfumishili lupasilu; Ilaŋa dinu bayi chinukukenamuku, china chiwukukeneyi.
Hakwinza, hakuyiwana namutulu, hakumwila Petulu nindi, Eyi Shimona, wudi namutulu? Hiwunatweshi kutona hela mpinji yimuku?
Tonenu, lombenu, mubuli kwijila mukweseka. Chalala spiŋtu yinakeŋi, ilaŋa mujimba wunazeyi.
Hakufumaku cheŋi, hakuya nakulomba, wahosheli mwomumu.
Hakwinza, hakuyiwana cheŋi namutulu, muloŋa mesu awu aswejeli kulema, hiyelukili nimwakumwakwilaku.
Hakwinza cheŋi kamuchisatu, hakuyila nindi, Ichi dinu kamenu kwenu munooki; chinawani dehi; mpinji yinashi ki dehi; talenu, Mwana kamuntu anamufukeji dehi kumakasa awakwanshidi.
Nyamukenu, tuyenu; talenu wukunfukeja hadi kwakwihi.
Hohenohu, iku wuchidi kuhosha, Yudasi wahekumi nayedi hakwinza nezaza dawantu akweti mpoku jatubali ninyitondu, anafumi kudi awakulumpi jawatupristu nikudi ansoneki nikudi awakulumpi.
Henohu mukwakumufukeja wayileja dehi chinjikijilu chakwila nindi, Yowu nukupwepula, diyi mukukwata, mumutwalaŋa chachiwahi.
Chanashikiyi, hohenohu enza nikudi Yesu, nindi, Eyi Rabi. Hakumupwepujola nankashi.
Niwena amwolwela nimakasawu, amukwata nikumukwata.
Wumu wahadi owu emenuku, hakuhola mpoku yindi yakabali, hakutapa nduŋu yakapristu muneni, kutapa kwakumuketula itu dindi.
Yesu hakuyila nindi, Munenzi nakunkwata neyi chakukwata mukwakubuwa, nampoku jatubali nanyitondu?
Nadiŋi nenu mutembeli nakuyileja hefuku hefuku, enu kunkwata nehi; Ilaŋa nyikanda yajila chiŋa yilumbuluki.
Wejima wawu amushiyili, atemukili.
Hadiŋi mukwenzi weyala wumu wayili nindi, wadiŋi wadikumbakana ihina ditooka hamujimba wamukunkulu;
hiyakumukwata niyena, hakushiya odu ihina ditooka, hakutemuka nzekesi.
Hiyakumutwala Yesu kudi kapristu muneni; hikukupompa chimu nayena awakulumpi jawatupristu ejima, niakulumpi niansoneki.
Petulu hakumulondela munyima hahalehi, lwe nimuchipaŋu chakapristu muneni; hakushakama chimu naawatulama nakwota kesi muchejeji chakesi.
Henohu awakulumpi jawatupristu nachota chejima hiyakukeŋakeŋa wunsahu wakumujaha nachu Yesu, hiyawumwenuku.
Muloŋamavulu ashimwini wunsahu wakumutwambila, wunsahu wawu hiwatiyaŋenuku.
Amakwawu emeni nakushimuna wunsahu wakumutwambila,
nawu, Etu twamutiyili nakuhosha nindi, Ami nakasanda tembeli iyi yakutuŋa namakasa, nakatuŋa yacheŋi yaka kutuŋa namakasa mumafuku asatu.
Hela chochu; wunsahu wawu hiwatiyaŋenuku.
Kapristu muneni hakwimana mukachi, hakumwihula Yesu nindi, Eyi kwakula nehi? Wunsahu wudi nakushimunawu antu awa wunayi mudihi?
Ilaŋa Yesu saŋa amwenenayi zo-o, kwakula nehi. Kapristu muneni hakumwihula nindi, Yeyi Kristu, Mwana kaMukwakukisulewa, tahindi?
Yesu nindi, Yami. Mwamba kamona Mwana kamuntu nashakami kuchikasa chachidiilu chaŋovu, hakwinza namavu amwiwulu.
Kapristu muneni hakutabula mahinindi nindi, Ayinsahu amakwawu aadi.
Munatiyi chanatukiyi Nzambi; munatoŋojoki nenwidi? Hiyakumuhisha wejima wawu nawu nateli kufwa.
Amakwawu hiyakutachika kumufwŋila mazeŋi, hiyakumubuta kumesu, hiyakumweta makaha, hiyakumwila nawu, Profwetaku. Niatulama hiyakumutambola nakumwetola namakasa.
Chadiŋiyi Petulu mwishina muchipaŋu, hikukwinza wumu wahadi ayaloŋadima akapristu muneni;
chanamoniyi Petulu wudi nakwota kesi, hakumutala nindi, Eyi nawa wadiŋi hamu naniwu Yesu kaNazareta.
Ilaŋa yena hakudikala nindi, Chiwunahoshi ami hinachilukuku, hela kushinshikamu nehi. Hakwidika, hakuya mwikeki, ikombu edikila nikwidikila.
Owu chaŋadima hakumumona, hakutachika cheŋi kuyileja antu emenuku nindi, Iwu diyi mwinawu.
Ilaŋa yena hakudikalamu cheŋi. Chihanalehi chanti, antu emenuku hiyakumwila Petulu nawu, Chalala chi, yeyi mwinawu, muloŋa wukaŊaliliya.
Ilaŋa yena hakutachika kudishiŋa nikusanyika nindi, Iwu muntu mukutena, ami kwami hinamwilukaku.
Henohu ikombu edikila nikamuchiyedi. Petulu hakwanuka mazu amwililiyi Yesu nindi, Hakela ikombu kanda edi kili kayedi eyi wakadikalami kasatu. Chatoŋojokeliyi mwenomu hakudila.
